Junior Business Systems & Automation Developer – Dayton, OH

Full-Time | On-Site

Build Smarter Solutions. Turn Technology Into Results.

Technology is changing the way businesses operate, and at Logan Services, we're looking for someone excited to be part of that change. We're hiring a Junior Business Systems & Automation Specialist to help us use AI, automation, and connected business systems to work smarter, improve efficiency, and create better experiences for our employees and customers.

If you're naturally curious about technology, enjoy experimenting with AI tools, and love finding ways to make things easier and more efficient, this is an opportunity to turn that interest into a career.

You don't need years of software development experience or advanced coding skills. We're looking for someone with hands-on interest in AI and automation, strong problem-solving abilities, and the motivation to learn, build, and grow.

Why You'll Love Working at Logan
Competitive pay
Performance bonuses & profit sharing
Medical, dental & vision insurance
Company-paid life & AD&D insurance
Short- and long-term disability coverage
401(k) with 4% company match + Roth option
PTO & paid sick time
Paid training and ongoing development
Career growth opportunities
A stable, family-owned company with a strong reputation
The Impact You'll Make

You'll help identify opportunities to improve how Logan Services operates by turning everyday business challenges into practical technology solutions.

Build, configure, test, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that improve business operations.
Use AI-assisted development tools and low-code/no-code platforms to create solutions that reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
Develop automated workflows that connect business applications and streamline the movement of information between systems.
Use tools like Zapier to automate repetitive tasks, improve accuracy, and eliminate unnecessary steps.
Partner with the Director of IT & Business Systems to understand business needs and turn ideas into working technology solutions.
Help develop automated reports, dashboards, and tools that give employees and leaders better access to information.
Test new solutions to ensure they work properly, produce accurate results, and meet business requirements.
Monitor existing automations, troubleshoot issues, and identify long-term solutions when something isn't working as expected.
Assist with building and improving AI agents, including refining prompts, instructions, and capabilities.
Help employees and departments identify opportunities to use AI and automation in their daily work.
Follow established security guidelines to protect company information and ensure appropriate oversight of automated processes.
Document workflows, configurations, and changes while communicating project progress and potential issues.
Stay up to date on emerging AI tools and technologies and bring forward ideas that could benefit the business.
Provide occasional support to IT team members and internal employees as needed.

You're not just building automations. You're helping eliminate repetitive work, improve the employee experience, and shape how Logan Services uses technology.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is curious, resourceful, and excited about technology. You don't have to know everything coming into this role, but you should enjoy figuring things out, testing new ideas, and learning how to make technology work better.

You'll be a great fit if you are:

Interested in AI, automation, and emerging technology.
Comfortable experimenting with AI tools and exploring how they can solve real-world problems.
A quick learner who enjoys figuring out new software, platforms, and systems.
Analytical and able to break down problems to find practical solutions.
Detail-oriented and committed to testing your work and getting things right.
Organized and able to manage projects, communicate progress, and follow through on assignments.
Comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and working collaboratively.
Able to explain technical concepts and solutions to people who may not have a technical background.
Responsible and trustworthy when handling confidential information and company systems.
Someone who takes ownership and looks for opportunities to improve the way things are done.

An associate or bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, business technology, or a related field is preferred. Relevant coursework, certifications, internships, personal projects, or equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.

Recent graduates and early-career candidates are encouraged to apply!

Previous experience is not required, but familiarity with any of the following is a plus:

Creating or configuring AI agents, prompts, or AI-powered applications.
Building automations using Zapier or similar platforms.
Creating reports, dashboards, or data visualizations.
Working with APIs, databases, web applications, or connected business systems.
Exposure to Git/GitHub or software development environments.
Basic knowledge of SQL, JavaScript, or other programming languages.
Identifying inefficient business processes and finding ways to automate them.
Why Logan?

Since 1969, Logan Services has grown from a local company into a family-owned organization serving Dayton, Columbus, Cincinnati, and Northern Kentucky. But we've never lost sight of what makes our business successful: people. We believe in developing our employees, promoting from within, and giving our team the training and support they need to build a career.

As we continue to grow, we're investing in technology that helps our employees work smarter and our business operate more efficiently. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with leadership, explore emerging technologies, and make an impact across multiple departments.

Our culture is built around our PARTE Values:

People First | Agile | Radical Ownership | Teamwork | Excellence

Equal Opportunity Employer

Logan Services, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.
